newsitem.title: USA: Ingram Micro IPO delayed, pending IRS ruling.
newsitem.headline: Ingram Micro IPO delayed, pending IRS ruling.

text.p: The initial public offering of Ingram Micro Inc has been moved to mid to late October, pending a U.S. Internal Revenue Service ruling, lead underwriter for the deal, Morgan Stanley & Co, said on Friday.

A spokeswoman for the syndicate department at Morgan Stanley said that a tax ruling for the Ingram Micro Inc split-off from its parent company, Ingram Industries Inc, was still pending and that it was expected in early October.
She said that the offering of 20 million shares of Ingram Micro, with a price range of $14 to $16 a share, was now expected to price the week of October 14.
"We hopefully will get it (the ruling) after the first week of October, at which time we hope to resume our U.S. roadshow," she told Reuters.

Shares of Ingram Micro Inc, a California-based distributor of microcomputer products with sales in 1995 of $8.6 billion, are expected to trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "IM" Morgan Stanley added.
